# Compify

> Build UI components in a live browser editor, publish them as @user/name,
> and install them anywhere via the shadcn registry protocol or the compify CLI.

## For coding agents

- Install a public component into a shadcn project:
  `npx shadcn@latest add https://api.compify.app/r/<user>/<name>.json`
- Or configure the namespace once in components.json:
  `"registries": { "@compify": "https://api.compify.app/r/{name}.json" }`
  then: `npx shadcn@latest add @compify/<user>/<name>`
- Public component index (shadcn registry.json format):
  https://api.compify.app/r/registry.json
- Component metadata: GET https://api.compify.app/c/info/<id>
- Live preview pages (public, no auth): https://compify.app/view/@<user>/<name>
- compify CLI: `compify add @<user>/<name>` (docs: https://github.com/kubet/compify/blob/main/docs/cli.md)

## Docs

- Registry interop: https://github.com/kubet/compify/blob/main/docs/registry.md
- CLI reference: https://github.com/kubet/compify/blob/main/docs/cli.md
- Publishing: https://github.com/kubet/compify/blob/main/docs/publishing.md
